Turnitin does not decide whether plagiarism has occurred
Students may be required to attend a viva or meeting to explain and verify their work in order to support the authenticity of their submission.

process.anchor: What happens if Malpractice is suspected?

process.quote: If the issue is considered minor malpractice, you may be invited to meet with the Module Leader.
If the issue is considered major malpractice, you will be invited to attend a Major Malpractice Panel of Inquiry.
A Malpractice Panel of Inquiry is a formal meeting, usually held online.
You may bring a support person (for example another student or a Students’ Union Advisor)
If you choose not to attend, a decision may still be made
You will be asked to respond to the allegation

In some cases, particularly where fitness to practise is affected, malpractice may lead to further formal procedures being initiated, which can be recorded on your academic record and affect future opportunities such as employment or further study.

outcomes.quote: A requirement to resubmit the work within a set timeframe
